verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing platform, so the question of which card program types it supports applies. However, the evidence only covers card form factors (virtual, physical, tokenized) and generic card programs. Nothing documents debit, prepaid, commercial credit, or consumer credit programs specifically.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform supports the card types my product needs — debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs — not just one prepaid rail
